work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CXLIX (OCR . CIL.; address LF31982–31986 to Pedro de Alcántara, bishop of Antiphellus and vicar apostolic of Bombay; protocol LF31989) after Stabellini’s resignation lets him choose a coadjutor with right of succession and elect him bishop of Calama; LF32005 → LF32045 across the Leo XII note continuation (LF32008–32036, another act), own provenance LF32039 and running title LF32042; dated 8 August 1837 (Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maiorem die octava augusti). Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF31989–31989; the source closing at LF32100–32103 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem die octava augusti millesimo octingente- simo trigesimo septimo, pontificatus Nostri anno septimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
